notes: How far the player's character sees a vehicle on the ground (simcore/nav/session.hpp): within it the world's movers run at full detail (M2) and are drawn; beyond it by its margin they go back to M1. The light by the sun's elevation (day above the horizon, civil twilight to -6 degrees, night below), the weather's visibility the cap.
source: game values (the eye's range for a vehicle on open ground by day, at dusk and by night with headlights or a moon); civil twilight's -6 degrees is the astronomical definition

day_m.source: game value: a column of vehicles on a road seen across open country by day

twilight_m.source: game value: the same at dusk or dawn

night_m.source: game value: headlights and dimmed lights, or a moon

night_blackout_m.source: vokrachko_1963 (a blacked-out vehicle's rear distance indicator is designed to be seen only from the next vehicle, its figures from 150 m in)
night_blackout_m.notes: A vehicle with no outside lights at night (the light discipline, voenizdat_osa_1991 p222): seen no farther than this (nav/movers.hpp, Mover::lit).

twilight_deg.source: derived: civil twilight, the sun up to 6 degrees below the horizon (the astronomical definition)

margin.source: game value: back to M1 only beyond the range by this share, so a mover at its edge does not flicker
